# Geomacro

> Geopolitical and macro risk intelligence infrastructure for human and machine decisions.

Geomacro turns real-world geopolitical, macroeconomic and strategic-resource developments into structured, explainable risk intelligence. The primary product is the intelligence layer: live risk intelligence, the Global Risk Index (GRI), grounded research, machine-readable Risk Objects and Risk Gate decision context.

## Current product status

- Risk Intelligence: LIVE
- Global Risk Index (GRI): LIVE
- Ask Geomacro: LIVE
- Research and methodology: LIVE
- Risk API: PRIVATE PILOT
- Risk Gate: PRIVATE PILOT
- Risk Gate country-review coverage: 114 of 194 enabled sovereign countries accepted by the controlled production workflow census on 2026-09-16; 80 remained fail-closed
- Accepted sovereign-fiscal path split in that census: 57 World Bank QPSD + 57 governed World Bank PPG
- Every accepted census result preserved `execution_authorized=false`
- World Bank QPSD governed production source: promotion gate passed and commercial-signal source remains active
- Paid agent / x402 access: PRE-LAUNCH; non-production acceptance only
- Coinbase x402: INITIAL LAUNCH COHORT; Base mainnet disabled pending coordinated launch
- Circle Gateway x402: INITIAL LAUNCH COHORT; dedicated route prepared; Base mainnet disabled pending coordinated launch; Arc mainnet not enabled
- Nevermined: INITIAL LAUNCH COHORT; production/live disabled pending coordinated launch
- GOAT Testnet3: TECHNICAL PROOF ONLY
- GOAT mainnet: DEFERRED pending manual merchant application/approval; not an initial-launch blocker
- Arc Testnet, prediction markets, Circle CCTP and Bridge & Swap: TECHNICAL PROOF

Technical-proof surfaces are secondary to the risk-intelligence product and must not be interpreted as production mainnet, real-money institutional settlement or independent security certification.

## Machine access and payment boundary

- Agent discovery: https://geomacro.live/.well-known/geomacro-agent.json
- Commerce discovery: https://geomacro.live/.well-known/geomacro-commerce.json
- No-charge x402 deliverability check: POST https://geomacro.live/api/x402/risk/availability
- Coinbase pre-launch adaptive intelligence resource: POST https://geomacro.live/api/x402/intelligence
- Circle Gateway pre-launch adaptive intelligence resource: POST https://geomacro.live/api/x402/circle/intelligence
- Nevermined sandbox adaptive intelligence resource: POST https://geomacro.live/api/x402/nevermined/intelligence
- The payment challenge/provider plan is the authoritative source for price and accepted payment terms; static discovery metadata is not authoritative pricing.
- The exact requested intelligence must pass deliverability checks before a payment challenge is issued.
- Requests with unavailable, stale or commercially ineligible required coverage are not chargeable.
- A successful machine payment unlocks only the bounded requested product; it does not widen the customer's entitlement or expose raw/private warehouse data.
- Payment does not authorize a downstream financial action. Risk Gate remains non-authorizing and `execution_authorized=false`.
- During pre-launch, all real-money provider activation remains disabled even if an individual adapter is technically ready.

## Current machine-readable request scope

Supported subjects:

- country by ISO3 code;
- directional corridor by origin ISO3 and destination ISO3.

Supported adaptive topics:

- sovereign risk;
- macro risk;
- FX/external risk;
- sanctions/restrictions context;
- conflict/geopolitics;
- trade-corridor context;
- energy/commodities;
- critical minerals;
- political/governance risk;
- banking/financial-system context;
- food/agriculture;
- natural hazards;
- hot topics;
- Risk Gate;
- signed Risk Object;
- GRI context.

Supported intents include single-subject assessment, comparison, bounded ranking/filter, directional corridor, change-since, audit/provenance and Risk Gate evaluation.

## Key product boundaries

- Geomacro provides external risk context. It does not custody customer funds or authorize customer transactions.
- Risk Gate currently keeps `execution_authorized=false` at the Geomacro boundary.
- The current Private Pilot Risk Object / Risk Gate scope is country and directional corridor risk.
- The latest controlled production census measured 114 accepted sovereign countries out of 194 enabled sovereign countries. This is current four-module country-review coverage, not an all-country guarantee or a claim that every paid product is deliverable for all 114 under every request shape.
- The remaining 80 countries fail closed when one or more required current inputs cannot be verified.
- GRI is an evidence-weighted risk-intelligence measure, not a market probability and not a guarantee of future outcomes.
- Missing or unavailable evidence is not silently converted into zero risk.
- Sanctions/restrictions context is not a replacement for sanctions screening or legal/compliance review.
- Corridor composition does not imply full physical-route, vessel, counterparty or logistics-path modelling.

## Commercial launch cohort

The initial coordinated commercial launch cohort is Coinbase x402, Circle Gateway x402 and Nevermined. All three remain production-disabled until the frozen release candidate passes required product, security, source-rights, payment, delivery, reconciliation and evidence gates and receives explicit owner authorization.

Circle production discovery remains hidden unless the dedicated Circle environment, global launch acknowledgement, provider acknowledgement and central real-funds security gate are all satisfied. Arc mainnet is not part of this prepared launch path.

GOAT mainnet is excluded from the initial cohort until manual merchant application/approval is complete. GOAT Testnet3 remains non-revenue technical proof and the mainnet runtime remains fail-closed.

## Marketing boundary

Verified production milestones may generate private evidence-backed marketing drafts for owner review. Testnet/sandbox activity is never treated as commercial revenue. Automatic public posting is disabled; every external post requires explicit owner approval.
